dedupe_keys.name: bentley itwin platform infrastructure digital twin apis and services

description: The iTwin Platform is Bentley Systems' collection of APIs and services for building, deploying and scaling infrastructure digital twin applications, aimed at developers, system integrators and software companies. It combines engineering and design data (CAD, BIM and engineering models), reality data (photos, point clouds, meshes and drone captures), GIS, IoT and sensor feeds, schedules and operational and enterprise data from Bentley and third-party systems into synchronised digital twins. Bentley lists capabilities for digital twin management, visualisation, reality data processing, change tracking, access control, reporting and integrations, and says the services support production applications in transportation, utilities, cities, industrial facilities and construction. User stories on the page include augmented-reality site navigation, pipeline failure prediction, traffic design data management and AI field audits of road and rail assets. Coverage: generic; any asset whose data are loaded. Access: developer portal with documentation, webinars and forums; pricing is on request. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the page gives no prices or free-tier terms, and applications must be built on the APIs. Simulation uses: building and campus digital twins that link BIM with sensors for operations, and infrastructure asset twins for condition and resilience studies. Related records: Autodesk Tandem, Azure Digital Twins, IFC and the CesiumJS platform.
